item.title: Top stars Mirra Andreeva and Linda Noskova enter the 2027 Porsche Tennis Grand Prix
item.description: The Grand Slam champions Mirra Andreeva and Linda Noskova are the first top stars to enter the 2027 Porsche Tennis Grand Prix. The long-established tournament will take place in Stuttgart’s Porsche Arena from 10 to 18 April. Tennis fans will receive a ten per cent discount on selected seats in a special Christmas offer from 1 to 24 December.

item.title: McLaren-TAG-Porsche MP4/2: The turbo that conquered Formula One
item.description: Motorsport Magazine looks back at some of the most significant single-seaters powered by Porsche technology. This time: the McLaren-TAG-Porsche MP4/2, whose Porsche-developed V6 turbo engine helped propel McLaren back to the top of Formula One.

item.title: Porsche 911 GT3 Tribute to 911 GT1 celebrates a racing icon
item.description: The unique Porsche 911 GT3 Tribute to 911 GT1 celebrated its world premiere in Guangzhou today. Initiated and led by Porsche China, this commission project was developed over 1,5 years in collaboration with Porsche Sonderwunsch and Style Porsche and Studio F. A. Porsche.

item.title: Porsche 911 GT3 R wins championships and races worldwide in 2026
item.description: The upgraded Porsche 911 GT3 R secured numerous victories and championship titles worldwide in its first season. Porsche Motorsport’s customer teams triumphed in the Intercontinental GT Challenge, the DTM and the GT World Challenge Europe, amongst others.

item.title: Development of first all-electric 718 Boxster reaches the home straight
item.description: Highly emotive driving experience: Porsche’s first all-electric two-door sports car is in the starting blocks. After an extensive testing programme, the new 718 Boxster, featuring the sports-car-specific E-Core layout, is on the home straight of its development as a production vehicle.

item.title: Porsche presents new-generation dashcam
item.description: Porsche is expanding its range of accessories with the new Dashcam Gen. 2. The multi-camera system automatically records relevant driving and parking events, combining high-resolution footage with intelligent sensors.

item.title: Icons of Porsche 2026 brings heritage and a vision of the future
item.description: From a forward-looking vision model to a 924 that escorted royalty, the 2026 Icons of Porsche event brought together some remarkable cars and the people who cherish them. The sixth edition welcomed the Porsche community to a new setting in Dubai for a weekend of automotive heritage, design and culture.

item.title: Porsche teams to conclude pre-season testing with the new Porsche 975 RSE
item.description: The Porsche teams set to compete in the 2027 ABB FIA Formula E World Championship will complete their final preparations for the new season on Friday afternoon in Spain. Since Monday, six all-electric Porsche 975 RSE race cars have been on track together for the first time at the all-electric championship’s official test in Jarama.

item.title: Anton Marklund explores Northern Sweden from forest roads to racetrack
item.description: Four-time European Rallycross champion and former Porsche Carrera Cup Scandinavia driver Anton Marklund takes us on a Sunday Drive through his home region in Northern Sweden – with a stop along the way at Sweden’s longest racetrack.

item.title: A Pharmaceutical Company Puts Transfer First
item.description: Top quality and the highest delivery reliability across its global operations are among the most important performance indicators for German pharmaceutical manufacturer Boehringer Ingelheim.

item.title: Porsche Golf Circle celebrates 75 Years of Porsche Motorsport
item.description: 40 Porsche Golf Circle members from eight countries met up on Tenerife for a special community event with some highly diverse golf experiences, personal encounters with works driver Julien Andlauer and the Porsche Brand Ambassador Paul Casey as well as the premiere of the Porsche Golf Circle Champions Trophy.

item.title: Porsche 804: The Formula One winner
item.description: Motorsport Magazine looks back at some of the most significant single-seaters in Porsche history. This time: the Porsche 804, the car that delivered Porsche’s first and, to date, only Formula One victory as a constructor in 1962.

item.title: Learning from a Champion: On the Hungaroring with Jörg Bergmeister
item.description: Entrepreneur Bruce Dereschuk wants to master his 911 GT3 RS on the racetrack with complete confidence. What better way than to learn personally from a former professional racing driver at the Porsche Track Experience?

item.title: Porsche Junior 2027: Five-day assessment completed
item.description: Twelve promising young racing drivers took part in a screening process in Cologne and at the Autódromo Internacional Algarve. Their goal: to become the 35th Porsche Junior. Over the past 29 years, the development programme has produced numerous world champions and Le Mans winners, as well as, most recently, two DTM champions. For the first time, professional sim racers are participating in a separate selection procedure for a development package in real-world motorsport.

item.title: Porsche 718/2: From sports car to Formula One frontrunner
item.description: Motorsport Magazine looks back at some of the most significant single-seaters in Porsche history. This time: the Porsche 718/2, a car never intended for Formula One, yet one that took on the very best in 1961.

item.title: Banzai Legacy Lab: Culture in Motion
item.description: For Thomas Schlereth, his vehicles are living cultural treasures. At the Banzai Legacy Lab, he brings together sports cars, skateboards, art, and people, connecting the past with the present.

item.title: Twelve talented drivers compete for the status of Porsche Junior 2027
item.description: Twelve young racing drivers from ten countries are taking part in the selection process for the 2027 Porsche Junior Programme. The winner will receive financial support for the upcoming season in the Porsche Mobil 1 Supercup, as well as comprehensive support from Porsche Motorsport.

item.title: From Dependency to Sovereignty
item.description: Winning the new industrial race through speed, scale and strategic industry clusters.

item.title: Porsche Timepieces: A new era of timekeeping
item.description: At the heart of Switzerland’s legendary watchmaking triangle, Porsche Design has opened its new timepieces manufactory. Both the region and the building itself are steeped in centuries of horological tradition, while the state-of-the-art facility produces precision chronometers with the efficiency and discipline of Porsche’s manufacturing principles, creating exclusive, one-of-a-kind timepieces.

item.title: Royal duty: Historic Porsche 924 restored
item.description: The restoration by Porsche Centre Abu Dhabi and Al Ain brings an important piece of UAE automotive history back to life.
